final: WITH customer_averages AS (SELECT i.CustomerId, c.Country, AVG(i.Total) AS customer_average FROM Invoice AS i JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY i.CustomerId, c.Country), country_averages AS (SELECT Country, AVG(customer_average) AS country_average FROM customer_averages GROUP BY Country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(country_average) AS overall_average FROM country_averages) SELECT AVG(ca.country_average) AS average_country_average, AVG(ca.country_average - o.overall_average) AS average_excess FROM country_averages AS ca JOIN overall AS o ON o.overall_average IS NOT NULL WHERE ca.country_average > o.overall_average
